name.full: o-MATIC Server MCP Connector for Microsoft 365 Copilot

description.short: Entra SSO MCP connector for o-MATIC Server factories.
description.full: o-MATIC Server MCP Connector for Microsoft 365 Copilot. Default endpoint is https://factory.o-matic.ai/mcp with Entra SSO (OAuthPluginVault). Exposes the full live MCP tool surface. Connector only — not a declarative agent and not a persona. For a customer factory or other HTTPS MCP URL, rebuild with OMATIC_MCP_URL and OMATIC_OAUTH_REFERENCE_ID (see docs/CUSTOM-MCP.md); Microsoft's agentConnectors schema pins mcpServerUrl in the package with no runtime URL field.

connectorDescription: Default o-MATIC Server MCP endpoint with Entra SSO. Exposes the full MCP tool surface. Rebuild for a custom factory URL (docs/CUSTOM-MCP.md).
